findings.claim: App API book/division endpoints reject anonymous requests with business code 200001.
findings.description: Empty login_token/account cannot be used to access the App book chain.

evidence.source: 2026-07-12 inline minimal request; summary in analysis/auth-capability/report.md
evidence.value: HTTP 200; code=200001; tip=缺少登录必需参数

findings.claim: Public Web chapter pages provide an anonymous path for free chapter extraction.
findings.description: www pages expose current books/chapters and mip/wap chapter pages respond without login.

evidence.source: 2026-07-12 anonymous HTTP probes; summary in report.md
evidence.value: www/mip/wap HTTP 200; mip sample text length about 2.5K

redaction.notes: Chapter body omitted; only lengths and hashes inspected.

findings.claim: The password login endpoint remains online and expects login_name plus passwd.
findings.description: Local code, NateScarlet source, and current server validation agree on /signup/login.

redaction.notes: Online probe used synthetic invalid credentials.

findings.claim: A real account/password login attempt was confirmed to require captcha verification.
findings.description: The user manually verified the real credential path and observed a captcha requirement; challenge schema was intentionally not analyzed further.

evidence.source: User manual verification on 2026-07-12, cross-checked with GitHub evidence listed in report.md
evidence.value: Real account/password login requires captcha verification.

triage_items.description: Password-login captcha protocol is intentionally not pursued.
triage_items.reason: Real login was confirmed to require captcha, and the project will rely on App login plus token extraction.
triage_items.suggested_next: No action unless the project scope changes.

triage_items.description: Anonymous Web free-chapter provider is intentionally not implemented.
triage_items.reason: It adds little value to the project's bookshelf, purchased-chapter, and delisted-book backup goal.
triage_items.suggested_next: No action unless anonymous public-content download becomes a project requirement.
